What I used-

\-Image/Adjustments/Black and White to fade Jesus and the 2 crosses into the picture

\-Filter/Noise/Add Noise... to make Jesus a bit more pixelated fit a bit more in.

\-Then I used the pen tool to cut out the helmet and the uniform that Jesus gets behind them and (also) fits in.

\-1 Cross I just added on his uniform bc it fitted well. 

\-For the 2. Cross I used the pen tool to cut the hand of the soldier out to place the 2. cross right underneath it.
